items.does: Lists the organisation's regulatory programs, the 50 most recently updated, as cards or rows with search, workstream and status filters, and opens one into Project home. A full-canvas New Project wizard (pick a filing type from the shared filing catalog, product, TA or device classification, target date) creates a real program. That program gets a scaffolded governed document, a drug `submissions` spine and a PM-spine anchor in one transaction. The client sees a notice when the scaffold or the anchor is skipped.

It shows the program's identity facts (sponsor, product, indication, application number, or the full device classification for device and IVD programs) and per-CTD-module section completion. Only the Author stage has working content. The other six lifecycle tabs are signposts or empty.

items.label: Tasking (rail 'Tasking' and quick-access 'My Tasks')
items.does: An organisation-wide task board with Board, Critical path, Analytics and Table views. A user can: create a task with a real project and assignee; move it through the server state machine, with a 21 CFR 11.50 e-signature ceremony when a step needs signoff; archive it as a soft delete; link dependencies; auto-assign it to the member with the lowest workload; and instantiate a workflow template into linked tasks on a project. It also shows read-only cards from the schedule, correspondence and filing stores, each linking to the screen that owns it.
